prerequisites: Bootstrapped Minecraft registries and the Scarborough Fair generator codec
steps: Decode the shipped dimension JSON with RegistryOps and round-trip the custom generator codec
Generate center, inner-ring, and outer-ring chunk samples
Sample biome, surface column, features, ores, structure candidates, fluid level, and generated entities
assertions: Codec round-trip preserves biome source, shape settings, and content settings registry keys
Generated terrain contains floating islands separated by void with End shape and fluid settings
Observed biome, surface, feature, ore, structure, and mob semantics come from Overworld content

steps: Log in new and existing UUIDs under each configuration variant
Repeat candidate generation for the same world seed and UUID
Present solid, fluid, no-collision, cactus, magma, powder-snow, leaf, and normal surface fixtures
Force both successful and failed changeDimension results
assertions: Default configuration moves no player; enabled configuration moves only a truly new player once
Candidate sequence is deterministic and accepted positions are at least 1024 blocks from origin
Only collision-safe, fluid-free, non-hazardous surfaces with two clear body blocks are accepted
Personal respawn is set only after a successful dimension transition
